newsitem.title: USA: Peak Tech stock tumbles on weak outlook.
newsitem.headline: Peak Tech stock tumbles on weak outlook.

text.p: The stock of Peak Technologies Group Inc. tumbled Thursday, a day after the provider of inventory management services warned that operating results for the third quarter would lag analysts' estimates.
The stock fell $9.375 or more than 43 percent to $12.375 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
Peak attributed its disappointing outlook to weaker sales, order delays and one order cancellations during the quarter ended Sept. 30.
The New York-based company expects to break even on sales of $57 million to $58 million, compared with analysts' forecasts of 31 cents per share for the period.

"Results for the third quarter of 1996 will fall short of expectations due to an unexpectedly soft sales month in September following the traditionally slower business activity in July and August, particularly in Peak's European operations," Peak said.
Peak said September was historically the biggest month of the year for the company and usually represented up to 50 percent of the third quarter equipment and systems sales.
Peak said it would release final results on Oct. 24.
